## 1. Open Studio on the Projects pillar

The Projects pillar lists every project forge manages.

![Open Studio on the Projects pillar](/media/stories/S1/01-open-studio-on-the-projects-pillar.png)

## 2. Click "Onboard a project"

Onboarding asks for the few things a Factory needs before it can build a repo: what to call it, the quality gate that judges its work, and the north star that tells a planner what the project is for.

![Click "Onboard a project"](/media/stories/S1/02-click-onboard-a-project.png)

## 3. Fill in the name, the quality gate and the north star — and under Advanced, the repo path — then press "Onboard project →"

Registering the project lands the operator on its page, where forge immediately measures story-s1 against the project contract and reports the result honestly: a hard fail.

![Fill in the name, the quality gate and the north star — and under Advanced, the repo path — then press "Onboard project →"](/media/stories/S1/03-fill-in-the-name-the-quality-gate-and-th.png)

## 4. Open "Brief the agent", give it the north star and the gate command, and press "Run onboarding agent"

The operator does not fill the contract in by hand.

![Open "Brief the agent", give it the north star and the gate command, and press "Run onboarding agent"](/media/stories/S1/04-open-brief-the-agent-give-it-the-north-s.png)

## 5. Follow "View onboarding session"

The onboarding session opens on the shared session surface.

![Follow "View onboarding session"](/media/stories/S1/05-follow-view-onboarding-session.png)

## 6. Watch the Agent work through the contract until the onboarding session finishes

Onboarding is a dispatch, not a conversation.

![Watch the Agent work through the contract until the onboarding session finishes](/media/stories/S1/06-watch-the-agent-work-through-the-contrac.png)

## 7. Select the demo stage and hand it to the demo builder — the heavy one

Not every contract component is a question and an answer.

![Select the demo stage and hand it to the demo builder — the heavy one](/media/stories/S1/07-select-the-demo-stage-and-hand-it-to-the.png)

## 8. Come back to the demo builder, brief it, and lock the demo declaration it makes

Not every contract element is answered by talking.

![Come back to the demo builder, brief it, and lock the demo declaration it makes](/media/stories/S1/08-come-back-to-the-demo-builder-brief-it-a.png)

## 9. Return to the project and close whatever the agent could not

Preflight is MET.

![Return to the project and close whatever the agent could not](/media/stories/S1/09-return-to-the-project-and-close-whatever.png)

## 10. Press "Plan with Architect" and describe the first piece of work

With a contract in place the Architect can plan.

![Press "Plan with Architect" and describe the first piece of work](/media/stories/S1/10-press-plan-with-architect-and-describe-t.png)

## 11. Open the session, read the plan and press Approve

The plan is approved and committed.

![Open the session, read the plan and press Approve](/media/stories/S1/11-open-the-session-read-the-plan-and-press.png)
